Ability recasts are scheduled on one shared timeline (the champion has one set of hands): each cast occupies its sourced cast time, an ability recasts when its effective cooldown has elapsed and no other cast is in progress, and a cast counts when it starts within the window.

independent_computation.step_1_identify_the_slot: 'Q2' is not a fifth ability. Per S1/S6/S9 it is Syndra's SECOND STOCKED Dark Sphere charge; the calculator models the extra charge as a synthetic slot named Q2 (S7, S8). So the leaf question reduces to: at this scenario's splinter count, is a second Dark Sphere charge available to be cast as the second action of the rotation?
independent_computation.step_2_read_the_scenario_number: The scenario id 'syndra_custom_order_60' carries the value 60, which in Syndra's kit is a Splinters-of-Wrath count: the cached wiki gives exactly four Transcendent thresholds - 40 (Q second charge, S1), 60 (W bonus true damage, S3), 80 (E scatter/slow, S4), 120 (+15% AP, S2). 60 is one of those thresholds, and the splinter option is the documented 0-120 knob (S7/S8). No other Syndra quantity in the cached data equals 60.
independent_computation.step_3_threshold_test: splinters = 60. Q2 gate = 40. 60 >= 40 => TRUE. Therefore Dark Sphere is stocked up to a maximum of 2 charges (S1), i.e. the Q2 slot is unlocked and legal in this scenario. (Cross-check the other gates at 60: W true damage 60 >= 60 TRUE, E 60 >= 80 FALSE, P AP buff 60 >= 120 FALSE. A 60-splinter scenario is precisely the point where BOTH the second Q charge and the W true-damage upgrade are live - which is why W still belongs in the rotation, just not at index 1.)
independent_computation.step_4_castability_at_index_1: Charges are stocked, not cooldown-gated at the moment of use: with 2 charges banked, the second Dark Sphere can be cast immediately after the first, with no cooldown wait. The shared-timeline model (S10) only requires that no other cast is in progress and that the ability's own gate is satisfied; a stocked charge satisfies its gate at t=0. So Q -> Q2 back-to-back at timeline indices 0 and 1 is mechanically legal. Q's listed cooldown (7s flat, plus R's 10/20/30 ability haste to Dark Sphere) never blocks the banked second charge.
independent_computation.step_5_which_value_is_right: Both W and Q2 are individually legal casts at t~0, so legality alone does not settle the leaf; the discriminator is whether the second Dark Sphere charge is present in the timeline at all. Index 1 flipping from W to Q2 is an INSERTION of Q2 ahead of the still-present W, not a substitution of one ability for another - W's own 60-splinter upgrade (S3) is the reason the scenario sits at 60, so W cannot have been removed. The old timeline is exactly what you get when the Q2 slot is dropped from a rotation that names it: [Q, W, E, R]. The new timeline is what you get when the unlocked second charge is honored: [Q, Q2, W, E, R]. Since 60 >= 40 makes Q2 unlocked and castable (steps 3-4), dropping it is the error and honoring it is correct.
independent_computation.step_6_ordering_sanity_check: Casting both Dark Sphere charges before W and R is also the sphere-consistent order: W 'telekinetically grabs the nearest Dark Sphere' and R 'conjures 3 Dark Spheres and additionally grabs up to 4 nearby live ones' (data/champions.json, Syndra W/R effect text). Front-loading Q and Q2 guarantees live spheres exist for W's grab and for R's collection, so Q2 at index 1 is at worst neutral and at best strictly better than deferring it. There is no wiki-grounded reading in which the second charge must be withheld until after W.

residual_uncertainty: The scenario definition itself lives in scripts/ (golden snapshot), which this runbook forbids reading, so the requested cast order was not observed directly - the verdict is derived from (a) the cached wiki threshold 40 <= 60 making the Q2 charge unlocked and instantly castable, and (b) the fact that the flip is an insertion of Q2 ahead of a still-present W rather than a swap. The one reading that would make 'W' correct is a scenario whose splinter option is below 40, which contradicts the '60' in the scenario id and contradicts W's own 60-splinter upgrade being the point of the scenario.
